Founded by Horace B. Webb in 1941, Webb Air is a family-owned and operated HVAC company serving the greater Fort Worth TX area.
In the late 1930’s Horace owned a barber shop in Downtown Fort Worth. In between haircuts, HB passed the time talking to customers and reading books and magazines. He came across an article in a June 1939 edition of Popular Mechanics about a process that used evaporated water to cool surrounding air. He was inspired to design and construct his own evaporative cooling unit to make the shop more comfortable for patrons. It was an instant success. He soon left the front door to the shop open to allow passersby to experience the cooled air. It was not long before he was constructing Webb Coolers for residents and merchants in the Fort Worth area.
During the late 1930’s and early 1940’s with the help of family members the production and installation of Webb Coolers continued on a part-time basis until 1946. It was around this time that HB left his career as a barber to produce Webb Coolers full time for businesses and homes all over Fort Worth.
